text.p: These are the leading stories in the Tunisian press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Tunisian-Mauritanian joint high commission starts meeting in Nouakchott on Tuesday. Prime Minister Hamed Karoui attending.
- President Ben Ali Saudi Interior Minister.
-Tunisia, Qatar signed agreement on judicial cooperation.
-Tunisia, Czech Republic agree to promote and protect investment.
-Tunisia hopes exports will increase by 11 percent in 1997.
- Tunisia, Canada discuss cooperation in environment sector.
